primer: TSMC (NYSE: TSM) is the dominant pure-play foundry, making 3nm/2nm logic and CoWoS packaging for AI and mobile leaders. Fundamentals earn COMPOUNDER_PASS (Q3 2026 sales +41.2% YoY, 66.4% gross margin, 32.67% ROIC, 17.26x forward P/E). At $398.73, the market-facts ledger classifies TSM as Stage 1 Basing (-1.07% vs 200-DMA, above $351.19 low), while TradingView flags STAGE_4 (-5.17% below 30W SMA, -7.30% below 50D SMA). Both feeds agree TSM is not a buyable Stage 2 uptrend (CAP_REJECTED). New capital waits for $369.38–$380.64 support (3.20:1 asymmetry to $485 base target) while existing 2.3344 shares hold with a $348.00 stop.
